# The White Horse Is Not a Horse <span class="script">白馬非馬</span>

<p class="lens-meta"><code class="lens-code">BAIMA</code> · Chinese — 名家, 宋明理學, and the classics · <strong>Enforced — owns a gate</strong></p>

## The failure it names

sliding between a type and its tokens, or between intension and extension

## What it does

a claim quantifying over a class must declare that class's extension

## Enforced gates

These block a citation packet deterministically — no model in the loop:

- `PEIR-CLASS-EXTENSION-UNDECLARED`

## Worked example

"Amcache entries indicate execution" quantifies over every entry, having examined one. Gongsun Long's point is that the class and the qualified subclass are not interchangeable, however natural the slide feels.
